content.title: Olivier Rioux - Men's Basketball - Florida Gators
content.text: Olivier Rioux - Men's Basketball - Florida GatorsFlorida Gators Skip to Navigation Scoreboard (Slider) Select Sport to filter events 10 Men's Basketball events loaded2025-26 Men's Basketball RosterPosition: CenterHeight: 7-9Weight: 305Class: Redshirt FreshmanHometown: Terrebonne, Quebec, CanadaHigh School: IMG AcademyOverview Took a developmental redshirt season in 2024-25, serving on the Gators’ scout team. A member of Florida’s 2025 national championship team. Competed at IMG Academy in Florida. Guinness World Record holder for tallest teenager, Rioux stood 6-foot-1 at age eight, 6-foot-11 by sixth grade and crossed the 7-foot mark the summer before entering seventh grade. Appeared with Canada’s national team in several FIBA events, including the 2024 U18 FIBA AmeriCup, 2023 U19 World Cup, the 2022 U17 World Cup and the 2021 U16 Americas Championship. Rated a three-star prospect by 247Sports, On3 and Rivals. 2024-25, Redshirt Season Took a redshirt season to work on strength, conditioning and agility. Competed on the Gators’ scout team. International Experience Helped Canada to a bronze medal at the 2023 U18 FIBA AmeriCup while averaging 4.5 points and 4.5 rebounds per game, including 10 points vs. Venezuela and nine rebounds vs. Puerto Rico. Averaged 8.3 points and 10.3 rebounds over six games at the 2021 FIBA U16 Americas Championship. Played seven games at the 2022 FIBA U17 World Cup, averaging 2.7 points and 4.7 rebounds. Recorded 3.2 points and 3.4 rebounds per game in five appearances at the 2023 FIBA U19 World Cup. Personal Parents are Anne Gariepy and Jean-François Rioux. Has a brother, Émile. Has family members who played a variety of sports, including volleyball and swimming. Also competed in soccer and swimming while growing up. Came to Florida because he wants to work hard. Off the Court Chose #32 because of Magic Johnson and Shaquille O’Neal. Favorite food: Poutine If he could have a superpower, it’d be: Invisibility Favorite quote/saying: “The most important thing is that we all have each other, because we’re all in this together.” Newt in The Maze Runner Hidden talents: I can put my leg behind my head, and I can draw. If he could have dinner with three people: Julius Caesar, Cristopher Columbus, Torfin (a Viking) Favorite NBA players: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Shaquille O’Neal, Boban Marjanovic Favorite athlete outside the NBA: Leon Marchand Favorite place he’s traveled: Croatia Favorite holiday to celebrate, and why: Christmas, because you see the family. Favorite movies: The Maze Runner, Player One Favorite Book: Les Chevaliers d'Emeraude
